digest.tldr: Microsoft will remove the WSUS server role from Windows Server 2028, the next major release of its server operating system.

digest.title: Microsoft Store App Found Delivering Vinci RAT Capable of Remote System Control
digest.tldr: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a cyber attack in which a threat actor leveraged a Microsoft Store application to deliver a remote access trojan (RAT) called Vinci RAT.
